name: Talk of the Town
summary: Travelers seeking livelier company are directed toward Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. For wilder gatherings, they are sent to Nixxrax Fillamug at the Salty Sailor Tavern.

sections.title: A Word Across the Counter
sections.body: A friendly bartender sends travelers toward Booty Bay, where the port draws those who seek wilder spectacles. Drink servers pass the word to patrons, and it travels beyond the counter.

sections.title: The Salty Sailor
sections.body: The Salty Sailor Tavern stands in Booty Bay, amid Stranglethorn Vale. Goblins run the lively tavern, where Nixxrax Fillamug keeps the cups filled for all who enter.

faq.answer: The trail leads to Booty Bay, a goblin-run port in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Who are you supposed to find in Booty Bay?
faq.answer: You are sent to find Nixxrax Fillamug at the Salty Sailor Tavern, where he keeps the drinks flowing.

faq.q: Why send someone all the way to Stranglethorn Vale?
faq.answer: Bartenders hear gossip from their patrons, and word says the Salty Sailor Tavern holds the wildest gatherings around, though goblins run it.

attribution: In-game quest text: Talk of the Town
